title: AFKSpin
description: This plugin is currently in beta development. The plugin includes when player is in AFK for 60 seconds the player starts spinning. To stop the player from spinning you'll have to click your mouse, crouch or shift, and sliighty move your mouse
body:
Notice: This plugin is currently in Beta development.
The way this plugin works is that after the players is AFK so 60 seconds the player starts to spin around. 
To stop the player from spinning you need to click the mouse button, crouch[SHIFT], and move your mouse.
Use the command /afksettings to toggle killing while afk on or off.
Any issues, support, or feedback you want to give to me contact me on my discord server by cliking the link.
